titles.native: お昼のショッカーさん THEムービィー

description: The short was released along side the theatrical run of Kamen Rider Revice The Movie: Battle Familia and Avataro Sentai Donbrothers The Movie: New First Love Hero on July 22, 2022. It was later released to Toei Tokusatsu Fan Club on November 23, 2022.
